items.html: For in Katnut all of them are of BaN, as is known, for the seven kings were all of BaN. Also after the correction each of them took MaH and BaN, as is known, and then they were completed. And understand this well: for there is no MaH in Katnut at all, only in Gadlut. And it is: MaH — all the ten of his and of hers; and BaN — the three of his and the nine of hers.
